name: climbuk-brand-pack
description: The ClimbUK brand pack: tokens, logos, illustrations, photography, guidelines, templates and the Agent Skills that teach agents the brand.

scripts.check: python3 tokens/build_tokens.py --check && python3 ai/agents/build_agent_kits.py --check && python3 ai/prompts/build_prompts.py --check && python3 tools/check_dashes.py && node tools/dev/surfaces.mjs check && node tools/ai-docs/docgen.mjs --check
scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s tokens/tests && python3 -m unittest discover -s ai/tests && python3 -m unittest discover -s photos/tests
